description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and support our nursing team in a dynamic environment.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive and efficient work environment. We are looking for a compassionate leader who is committed to clinical excellence and staff development.This position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $60,000 to $75,000, with compensation based on your experience and qualifications. While an RN license is preferred, we encourage qualified candidates with strong leadership backgrounds to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
